author: Sample commentary (synthetic data)
headline: For the median committee, the ten largest named contributors account for 89% of named-source dollars.
paragraphs: Concentration asks how dependent a committee is on a few sources. Individuals are aggregated, so the top-10 share counts organizations and PACs only, and the stacked bar shows how much of each committee's total came from individuals, PACs, contractor-affiliated individuals and other organizations.
With a $500 limit per person, high concentration comes from PACs and independent expenditures, which the limit does not cover.

templates.template: {committees_fmt} committees, {years}: individuals gave {ind_share} of dollars, PACs and organizations {org_share}, contractor-affiliated individuals {contr_share}.
templates.fallback: Too few records match to summarize; widen the years or clear a filter.
